text:
Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which 
must be performed every six months as indicated by M6 in the title block.
Technical Specification:
11,12 BTA10 | 10 BTA20 | Battery title
OGI bloc 4V,230 | OSP.HC2100 | Battery type
2x27 | 2x62 | Number of cell / monoblocs
20-30 c | 20-30 c | Ambient temperature
2.23 v/cell | 2.23 v/cell | Battery voltage
The first draft initiated by eng. Mamdouh Ahmed Abd El-Gelil, tested by 
eng. Abd El-Gayed Abd El-Wahab Shawky Atalla, accepted by general manager eng 
Mostafa Abd El-Sattar El-Kalmoush 
and approved by eng. Ebrahim Mahmoud Aly Hassan head sector of Talkha Power Station.
This 
document revised by eng. Adel El-Naggar , certified by eng. Samir Abd El-Gelil 
general manager of quality control & MPIS coordinator and approved by eng. 
Mohamed Naguib Abd El-Hay head sector of inspection and quality control.
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be 
 issued, qualified maintenance staff carry the suitable safety 
 ID category
Safety fence 
 with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Use standard personal 
 safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, goggles 
 protective clothing rubber gloves .... etc
The door of the battery 
 room must be provided with No smoking signs
The battery 
 instructions must be displayed visibly on the wall
Water source must be 
 available in the battery room
When working in the 
 battery room bewares of parts under voltage
Complete tool set
Hydrometer
Digital voltmeter and 
 clamp meter
Grace battery
Thermometer
Work to be carried out
The following must be 
 measured and record every six months
Battery voltage
Voltage of few 
 selected cells monoblocs batteries
Electrolyte density 
 of few selected cell monoblocs batteries
Electrolyte 
 Temperature of a few selected cells / monoblocs
The level of a few 
 selected cells/ monoblocs
